{{Quote|These are the words of Vepon-Du. Mystic and master of nothing. This day I shall step from the Step of Harmony, my essence, my love, my life split. It is my death my vision scream for. My life that, if spared, will destroy Voss. Learn my words and know what it is to be Voss. I see my own death and I give all that I cherish. I am Voss. I do what must be done.|Writings of Vepon-Du|<ref name="March of Time">{{TORcite|type=faction|[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]|March of Time|[[Voss]]}}</ref>}}
The '''Writings of Vepon-Du''' were composed by a [[Voss Mystics|Voss Mystic]] named [[Vepon-Du]] many years before their [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was discovered by the galactic society. The writings were etched on a carving outside the [[Shrine of Healing]] in the [[Old Paths]].
